sup:DEMO-F1.text:
Guten Tag,

Thank you for your enquiry. Please find our Angebot below. 

As a family-run foundry, we deeply value our long relationship and take great pride in the dedication of our skilled team. In light of current market conditions, WAGES-METAL rose 3.1 % in twelve months and is 28 % of our cost. 

We are pleased to submit our offer at a price of €52.90 per unit, with a Zahlungsziel 30 days net, a contract term of 12 months, valid from 1 December 2026. Please note that this offer remains valid for 30 days.

We look forward to continuing our trustful cooperation and working together with you.

Viele Grüße aus der Gießerei
Andreas Moser
Owner, Demo Gießerei GmbH

move.text:
Guten Tag,

We have reviewed your offer and can adjust our Angebot as follows. We have carefully reviewed your counter-offer and are prepared to support your request for a 24-month contract and 60-day payment terms. Our Angebot stands at a price of €52.20 per unit, Zahlungsziel 60 days net, a contract term of 24 months, valid from 1 December 2026. 

To make these extended terms possible, we can revise our price to €52.20 per unit. We value our long-standing cooperation and trust this significant concession demonstrates our commitment to our partnership. Please note that this offer remains valid for 30 days.

Viele Grüße aus der Gießerei
Andreas Moser
Owner, Demo Gießerei GmbH

move.text:
Guten Tag,

It is always a pleasure to deal with our valued partners, and as a family-run foundry with deep roots in our industry, we deeply value the long relationship between our companies. We have carefully reviewed your offer and hold our Angebot. 

Having already made a significant concession to accommodate your requested 60-day payment terms and 24-month contract, we cannot reduce our price further. Our price reflects our costs; our calculation stays internal. We therefore maintain our offer of €52.20 per unit and ask you to reconsider your position. 

To be fully clear, our offer stands at a price of €52.20 per unit, Zahlungsziel 60 days net, a contract term of 24 months, valid from 1 December 2026. This proposal stays valid for 30 days.

We trust you appreciate the quality of our work and look forward to continuing our partnership.

Viele Grüße aus der Gießerei
Andreas Moser
Owner, Demo Gießerei GmbH

move.text:
Guten Tag,

We have reviewed your offer and hold our Angebot. 

It is with some surprise that we note your price proposals are moving backwards, which does not reflect the constructive spirit of our long-standing partnership. Having already accommodated your requests for 60-day payment terms and a 24-month contract, we have reached our limit for this package. 

We must therefore hold our offer of a price of €52.20 per unit, Zahlungsziel 60 days net, a contract term of 24 months, valid from 1 December 2026, and ask you to return to a realistic negotiation path. 

Please note that our offer stays valid for 30 days. Our standard terms apply to everything the quote does not state; see attached.

Viele Grüße aus der Gießerei
Andreas Moser
Owner, Demo Gießerei GmbH
